notes.title: New biome, Sandy Seafloor!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047322/0b4c2d478ad8529e95d6506bec4a54b84c9569ca.gif"][/img][/p][p]I've been developping the look and environment of the Sandy Seafloor biome, I may tweak it a bit still.[/p][p]There's a bunch of new stuff :

notes.title: Controller mapping & new mechanic!
notes.content: [p]I'm done with controller implementation![/p][p]-You can now remap actions to controller buttons how you want, with the exception of movement staying on analog stick (it would require way too much work for what it's worth).[/p][p]-Added a new sand block, a type of solid block through which your character can dash in straight line.[/p][p]Also, I made a new level (not playable yet) that uses the sand blocks, and fixed the music playing its base volume for a short moment when launching the game before going back to its saved volume.[/p][p]This new sand block and level are the start of a new biome, the sandy seafloor, that I'll be working on next. I'm so pumped to go back to producing actual content (I already coded 2 new enemies just for kicks).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047322/081b0ea71b9f0dea57a00ae9d5f3476fd25061aa.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Controller support
notes.content:
I finally worked on controller support. I also kept working on menus as part of the update.

-you can play and navigate menus with a controller now. However, I haven't implemented customizable buttons for controllers yet (hence why you can't enter the control settings with a controller). It is a non negligible amount of work to add in, so I think I will not include analog sticks in this.
-added an option to set the game's speed. I think this is mostly accessibility, I know for a fact that some levels ask for quick and precise movements, so that might help some people.

Other small changes :
-all settings & options can be accessed from main menu now
-language immediately changes on screen when it is set. Also fixed a few translation bugs.
-on the worldmap, levels with stars you haven't gotten yet will show it with dark blue star symbols (this way you know you still have stuff to collect in that level).

There's always menu stuff to improve... but I think it can finally wait a bit. I will try to implement controller customization, but I also want to work on new biomes/levels for a change.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45047322/13b013e8356b9fd57bdcd7bafa0391266a2ee1c6.png[/img]

notes.title: Menu improvement & fixes
notes.content:
I'm currently working on improving my game settings.

-you can now set your controls from the pause menu. The controls menu now also has a confirm window when you leave it, to make changes to controls clearer
-added a key to restart levels quickly (R by default, but you can change it)
-the amount of pearls you have can now be seen on the worldmap. They still don't have a use in the current demo, it'll come eventually
-added a loading scene for the start of the game
-small fixes on things such as the treasure death sound being able to play several times, enemy's speed when running away depending on fps, and an attempt to fix some returning wall clips
-many level design tweaks thanks to the feedback I got from the fest and streamers

Some new options are in the works like setting the game speed directly and disabling the "auto-jump" feature for a jump that feels less springy. Smart camera option is gone right now but will be back. Next I will add these settings and update the main menu options so they also show all the settings.
I also plan to work on controller support for the next update. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ivpoBE3.png[/img]

notes.title: More small demo changes
notes.content:
I made some small changes to smooth out the demo experience while also doing background stuff. The demo includes a new playable level, the Foam cave!

-tweaked the smooth camera to move differently when the character jumps
-adjustments to cosy courier level to make it teach better, and to several levels to tweak annoying hitboxes
 -fixed some bugs in djinn's cave

I took some time making some trailers for events and recording/editing a gameplay video. 
I am currently working on some shroud for the worldmap, but it isn't implemented yet.

The game will be up in Steam Next Fest next week, I hope you'll give it a try.
You can also do so right now, don't hesitate to wishlist if you like it! I'm always happy to get feedback. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u4g5Rku.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo fixes
notes.content:
Small fixes : 
-fixed some translation-related bugs, including one that caused the amount of stars collected to be wrong
-workaround a rare bug in the level map where the camera would not return to the character after unlocking a close level, causing the character to be unable to move

notes.title: Steam demo live!
notes.content:
You can now download the (free) demo of the game on steam and try it out! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccaiVd8.gif[/img]
I included a link to a feedback form, so if you like the game and want to help making it better this is a good way to give me your feedback. 
I wasn't able to make the discord link work directly for some reason, so you will need to find the community link on the store page to join it, if you want to talk about the game or just follow development. 

I made lots of adjustments for the demo version of the game, so that the experience is smoother. You'll find early levels and a few later ones to give you a taste of what's to come, as well as an improved help section. 

I also added french as a language setting. 

Additionally : 
[list]
[*]small UI fixes
[*]small level design fixes on An Inky Problem, Risky Loop and Turtle Cab
[*]fixed chest staying on turtles after the level ended in specific levels
[/list]

I will keep polishing this demo until the Steam Next Fest. After this, I will in a first time focus on processing the feedback I get, before going back to making the next biomes.

notes.title: Menu and UI update part 2
notes.content:
I kept working on the menus this month. I added a "settings" part in the pause menu with new options. 
[list]
[*]Added settings for music volume and sound volume in there
[*]Added settings for fullscreen and windowed in there
[/list]
Other options in that settings screen (control mapping & language) aren't implemented yet, although you can still configure your controls from the main menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Fo2iKB.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Control mapping menu can now be navigated with keyboard
[*]Added a "reset controls to default" button in there, as well as a "confirm controls" button which prevents errors
[*]Implemented menu icons lighting up properly and added some help text to navigate menus (there's still a few errors lurking that I must fix)
[*]The new settings are saved when you update them
[/list]
And that's it for this update. There's still menu stuff to do but my priorities lie elsewhere right now, I will be focusing on making the demo feel polished for the steam next fest to come.

notes.title: Menu and UI update (part 1)
notes.content:
I finally started working on the last big visual thing I'd postponed for so long : making the menus a bit handier and prettier. 

-Changed the text font
-New menu UI design, including new button and icon designs
-You can now navigate menus with arrow keys and confirm with pickup key (space by default). This isn't implemented on all menus yet
-When completing a level, you now go back to the worldmap and an unlock level animation is played, if relevant
-Fixed timed ticking while the level is paused
-Level design tweaks

I still have some work ahead of me for the menus I want to have, so I'll keep working on these aspects of the project.

notes.title: Level shop & new npc
notes.content:
Picking back up after the holidays, I worked on some new systems within the game, and some internal rearranging, so there's not much to show. 
-Levels now remember if you've collected stars in them, and display already collected stars, which are now saved.
-Added a new shop that you can access from the worldmap, with its shop npc. Talk to this npc to buy access to bonus levels (for now there's only 1 level to unlock, for showing purpose). 

I also spent some time upgrading the cover art and making a new store capsule art, and I'm pretty happy about the result. 
I'm still unsure about what I will work on next, I might try to give the UI its final form. My process will stay to polish and finish this early game section so that I can release the demo on steam as soon as I can.

notes.title: Treasure chest fixes, new foe, and more!
notes.content:
I'm done with revamping the chest's physics and collision systems. This change took a lot of time and work and fumbling alone in the dark, but now the mechanics seem a bit more robust and predictable. 

Fixes :
-changed the way the chest behaves with turtles, to make it more consistent and deal with a lot of bugs
-reduced the stuttering when a turtle lifts the chest from under
-the chest is no longer pushed to the side when dropped from under a corner

Content changes : 
-changed the look of switches and switch blocks so that they feel more like walls and buttons, and less like dangers
-level design tweaks to Risky loop, Inky problem and Cosy courrier

New stuff : 
-added a new danger, big clams that clap on your face and also destroy the chest, although they aren't in any level yet
-added an appear/disappear animation for the gold star you can collect

There are a few bugs left from the new system, but they're due to pixel perfect split second interactions mostly, I will have to see if I take time to work on them. Right now, I want to get back to adding content.

notes.title: Steam page, new biome, and more
notes.content:
The main update here is that this steam page is finally live, but there's other stuff!

-Visuals for a new biome, the clam plains. Only 2 levels (Chill blue shells/Follow that chest!) have been impacted yet, more will follow.
-Character can now dash diagonally. This comes in parallel to bugfixes about the dash going through walls in specific circumstances. If you encounter any bugs where you glitch through/inside walls, please let me know!
-Added new pearl collectibles you can only pickup while you carry the chest. They're only in a couple of levels so far but they'll propagate fast, believe me. 
-Added a victory animation when you finish a level. 

And that's all for now. Development is becoming easier and more fun, and I'll have more content out soon. I will also work on adding the demo version of the game here.
